title: Retro skill and the proposals test disagree on committing proposals
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15 S1: delivery-retro says commit `krn standards propose` output with the slice; test/cli/standards-proposals.test.ts:346 fails CI for any tracked proposal without an enforced pack record (run 43757521352).
Outcome: the retro skill and the test agree: either proposals stay untracked until harvested, or propose also writes the pack record.
Parked proposal: .krn/runs/lead/a-proof-or-acceptance-format-written-4cab289f.json (proof format parsed by its runner).
Proof: a slice that follows delivery-retro verbatim passes node --test test/cli/standards-proposals.test.ts.
